# Vendored third-party code

The directories below contain source code retained locally to run the normal-resolution detector. Their Git metadata is stored locally in `local_metadata/` so this repository can publish the source as normal vendor code rather than accidental nested Git repositories.

| Directory | Upstream repository | Revision retained |
|---|---|---|
| `Community-Forensics/` | https://github.com/JeongsooP/Community-Forensics | `ee5b71d43db0f3779e1edd64ee927b13f2dd6ad4` |
| `UniversalFakeDetect/` | https://github.com/WisconsinAIVision/UniversalFakeDetect | `030495aea3300a8b54c0ec37ec7fe1dd7e63c619` |

Each directory retains its upstream licence file. Follow those licences when redistributing or modifying this code.
